_meta.subject: physics
_meta.description: Seed entries for the GCSE Physics tier-1 vocabulary list. Definitions are paraphrased.

entries.subject: physics
entries.definition: The energy a moving object has because of its motion. Calculated as half mass times velocity squared.

entries.subject: physics
entries.definition: The energy needed to raise the temperature of one kilogram of a substance by one degree Celsius.

entries.subject: physics
entries.definition: For an ohmic conductor at constant temperature, the current through it is directly proportional to the potential difference across it.

entries.subject: physics
entries.definition: A wave in which the oscillation of the medium is parallel to the direction the wave travels; sound is the standard example.
